only-ext-traits.desc: Verifies that traits: - Are only defined in a `ext_traits` commons module (see import-rules check) - Are only implemented for external types (i.e. types not defined in our crate)
only-ext-traits.rationale: We want to disallow traits on our crate's types because our preference is: enums with dispatch functions (i.e. functions that match the enum variants to a function call) instead of traits.
